big_case.notes: Substantial border-infrastructure, environmental and cultural stakes, with a nationally relevant distinction between constitutional claims and statutory interpretation under a jurisdiction-limiting waiver statute. The ruling is interim, not final approval of the projects or resolution of every constitutional challenge.
